MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels useful because its screen and Alexa control could complement my Fire TV devices and compatible home cameras.",
    "The Blink bundle connects to my recent Blink camera purchase and could extend coverage to my doorway and other areas, although I would consider how much equipment it duplicates."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HD Fire TV Stick adds little when I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television; sharing the same streaming features does not create a new need.",
    "The tablet, smart plug, and Echo Flex lack a specific purpose in my current setup. My interest in connected devices does not mean I want every kind of device.",
    "The Echo speakers and smaller Show are relevant, but I would choose the Show 8 first rather than buy several devices with overlapping uses."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV and Blink purchases seem to have been taken as broad interest in Amazon devices, even when an item would not improve my home viewing or camera setup.",
    "The recommendations lean too heavily on more versions of devices I already own or could satisfy with a single purchase."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: a useful addition should provide a capability or coverage I am missing, rather than repeat my existing streaming equipment.",
    "My recent camera purchases make practical camera coverage and compatible viewing options more relevant than a general expansion into tablets or appliance automation.",
    "I would make a few purposeful purchases, choosing one suitable smart display before adding several similar voice-control devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in connected home viewing and cameras, but treated that interest too broadly and overlooked overlapping equipment and specific unmet needs."
}
